claim_assessments.statement: A projective generalized lc Q-pair over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, with fixed nef rational Cartier b-data, admits a non-extracting discrepancy-improving projective model with nef adjoint in the pseudo-effective case, or a connected-fiber lower-dimensional Mori contraction of relative Picard number one and relatively antiample adjoint otherwise.
claim_assessments.fidelity: All prime-divisor log discrepancies weakly improve, strictly for original contracted primes; the boundary is pushed forward and nef b-data stay fixed. No factoriality, generalized semiampleness or arbitrary-MMP termination is asserted.

claim_assessments.statement: The cyclic-character phase theorem follows from equivariant cone, product, valuation optimization, logarithmic Cartier selection, exact rounding, integral jump, lifting/mixing and bounded-fiber assertions.
claim_assessments.fidelity: Fixed-dimensional algebraic Gorenstein klt germs, finite cyclic actions on affine representatives, closed fixed points and canonical eigen-generators; arbitrary chosen group elements; a subsequence with uniformly bounded-discrepancy actual divisorial-scaled valuations and one positive integer valid for every rational semi-invariant, with integral-valued invariant-field restrictions that need not be primitive.

claim_assessments.statement: The source transfers the smooth canonical scaling-termination input through relative NQC weak Zariski decompositions to fixed-nef-data generalized existence and then to arbitrary algebraically closed characteristic-zero fields.
claim_assessments.fidelity: Relative decomposition is numerical over the base with rational nef/effective parts; the generalized transfer has lower-dimensional smooth-existence and NQC hypotheses, not universal termination or automatic factoriality.

supported_scope: Exact version-1 target statements, fixed-b-divisor normalization, discrepancy quantifiers, field and endpoint alternatives.
Source-attributed dependency chain and concrete local-to-global interfaces, not independent verification of their full machinery.
Transfer is credited by the manuscript to Tsakanikas-Xie with explicit hypotheses; rational nef data being NQC does not establish those hypotheses.
No supporting historical reviewer judgement covers the assigned claims; old finite-data/algebraic support is narrower and current native review is pending.

concrete_gaps.obligation: Construct actual centered bounded-discrepancy Gauss/divisorial valuations using the cone/product/Cartier-selection chain, fix uniform constants before the common rounding integer, preserve feasibility at dependent endpoints, and prove one congruence multiplier for all rational semi-invariants rather than a finite tuple.
concrete_gaps.old_evidence_limit: The Frobenius algebraic certificate has no such germs, actual valuations, degree-product bounds, uniform selection constants or all-functions extension. Deeper machinery is a named unreproduced dependency, not a claimed new error.

concrete_gaps.obligation: Prove uniform stabilization and valuation bounds for asymptotic multiplier ideals, countability of finite discrepancy-change limits, bounded canonical indices via cyclic-cover phases, and late-flip pushforward/rounding/regularity vanishing leading to a generated line with negative contracted degree.
concrete_gaps.old_evidence_limit: No old finite numerical certificate establishes a uniform late index, divisoriality of limiting valuations, a common Cartier index, or geometric vanishing on flips.

concrete_gaps.obligation: Construct a smooth branched cover with pseudo-effective canonical divisor, average its absolute nef/effective decomposition equivariantly, descend rational Cartier parts by finite norms, and remove the added base divisor only in relative numerical equivalence.
concrete_gaps.old_evidence_limit: Absolute smooth termination alone neither constructs the relative weak decomposition nor proves the rational Cartier and nef descent.

concrete_gaps.obligation: Check lower-dimensional relative smooth-existence and NQC transfer hypotheses, run the allowed scaling program without assuming factoriality, retain the same nef b-data in all discrepancy comparisons, prove Mori relative rank one, and descend the finite contraction/adjoint-algebra diagram to the specified characteristic-zero field.
concrete_gaps.old_evidence_limit: Catalogue citations and the observation that rational nef data are NQC do not provide existence, non-extraction, strictness, relative rank or finite-generation descent.

source_version.deeper_machinery: Cone, product, valuative, Cartier, integral-jump, tower, bounded-presentation, trait and incidence proofs were not proof-audited; their role is taken from the source's direct phase dependency routes.
